title: A prospective randomized split-mouth study of soft tissue augmentation with and without acellular dermal matrix after iliac onlay grafts in atrophied edentulous patients
summary: This prospective study aimed to evaluate clinically and histologically soft tissue augmentation in atrophied edentulous patients. At time of implant placement the soft tissue augmentation will be performed randomly with porcine –derived acellular dermal matrix Novomatrix TM (Test) compared to blank group (Control) in a split mouth design. After healing time of three months the thickness will evaluated clinically. Histologic specimens were analyzed by immunhistochemistry.

interventions.name: soft tissue Augmentation on the one site of the jaw with acellular dermal Matrix
on the other site without soft tissue augmentation
